title: 第一章：八十四天的等待与孤独的老渔夫
titleEn: Chapter 1: Eighty-Four Days of Drought & The Old Fisherman

sentences.chinese: 他是个独自在湾流中一条小船上钓鱼的老人，至今已整整八十四天没钓到一条鱼了。
sentences.pinyin: tā shì gè dú zì zài wān liú zhōng yī tiáo xiǎo chuán shàng diào yú de lǎo rén ， zhì jīn yǐ zhěng zhěng bā shí sì tiān méi diào dào yī tiáo yú le 。
sentences.english: He was an old man who fished alone in a skiff in the Gulf Stream and he had gone eighty-four days now without taking a fish.

sentences.chinese: 在头四十天里，有个名叫马诺林的小男孩跟他在一起。但过了四十天还没捕到鱼，孩子的父母便让他去了另一条船。
sentences.pinyin: zài tóu sì shí tiān lǐ ， yǒu gè míng jiào mǎ nuò lín de xiǎo nán hái gēn tā zài yī qǐ 。 dàn guò le sì shí tiān hái méi bǔ dào yú ， hái zǐ de fù mǔ biàn ràng tā qù le lìng yī tiáo chuán 。
sentences.english: In the first forty days a boy named Manolin had been with him. But after forty days without a fish the boy's parents sent him to another boat.

sentences.chinese: 老人消瘦而憔悴，脖颈上布满了深深的皱纹，双颊长满了褐斑，双手留着拉粗绳勒出的深长伤疤。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén xiāo shòu ér qiáo cuì ， bó gěng shàng bù mǎn le shēn shēn de zhòu wén ， shuāng jiá cháng mǎn le hè bān ， shuāng shǒu liú zhuó lā cū shéng lè chū de shēn cháng shāng bā 。
sentences.english: The old man was thin and gaunt with deep wrinkles on his neck, brown blotches on his cheeks, and deep-creased scars on his hands.

sentences.chinese: 然而，这一切都是古老的，唯有他那一双眼睛，像海水一样湛蓝，闪烁着欢快而不屈服的光芒。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér ， zhè yī qiē dōu shì gǔ lǎo de ， wéi yǒu tā nà yī shuāng yǎn jīng ， xiàng hǎi shuǐ yī yàng zhàn lán ， shǎn shuò zhuó huān kuài ér bù qū fú de guāng máng 。
sentences.english: Everything about him was old except his eyes and they were the same color as the sea and were cheerful and undefeated.

sentences.chinese: “桑提亚哥，”小男孩对他说，“现在我又攒了点钱，我可以陪你一起出海了。”
sentences.pinyin: “ sāng tí yà gē ， ” xiǎo nán hái duì tā shuō ， “ xiàn zài wǒ yòu zǎn le diǎn qián ， wǒ kě yǐ péi nǐ yī qǐ chū hǎi le 。 ”
sentences.english: "Santiago," the boy said to him, "I made some money again, I can go out with you once more."

sentences.chinese: 老人摇了摇头：“不，孩子，你跟了一条走运的船，留在那儿吧。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yáo le yáo tóu ： “ bù ， hái zǐ ， nǐ gēn le yī tiáo zǒu yùn de chuán ， liú zài nà ér bā 。 ”
sentences.english: The old man shook his head: "No, boy. You are with a lucky boat. Stay with them."

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，老人梦见了非洲的金黄海滩，梦见了黄昏时在海滩上像小猫一样嬉戏玩耍的狮子。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān wǎn shàng ， lǎo rén mèng jiàn le fēi zhōu de jīn huáng hǎi tān ， mèng jiàn le huáng hūn shí zài hǎi tān shàng xiàng xiǎo māo yī yàng xī xì wán shuǎ de shī zǐ 。
sentences.english: That night the old man dreamed of Africa's golden beaches and the lions playing like young cats in the twilight.

title: 第二章：驶向深海与巨大的马林鱼咬钩
titleEn: Chapter 2: Sailing into the Deep & The Giant Marlin Strikes

sentences.chinese: 第八十五天清晨，老人在天亮前就划着小船驶离了港口，独自划向那片深不见底的远海。
sentences.pinyin: dì bā shí wǔ tiān qīng chén ， lǎo rén zài tiān liàng qián jiù huá zhuó xiǎo chuán shǐ lí le gǎng kǒu ， dú zì huá xiàng nà piàn shēn bù jiàn dǐ de yuǎn hǎi 。
sentences.english: Before daybreak on the eighty-fifth day, the old man rowed his skiff out of the harbor, heading alone toward the unfathomable deep waters.

sentences.chinese: 太阳从海面升起，海鸥在空中盘旋。老人熟练地将带有沙丁鱼诱饵的钓线沉入一百英寻深的碧蓝海水中。
sentences.pinyin: tài yáng cóng hǎi miàn shēng qǐ ， hǎi ōu zài kōng zhōng pán xuán 。 lǎo rén shú liàn dì jiāng dài yǒu shā dīng yú yòu ěr de diào xiàn chén rù yī bǎi yīng xún shēn de bì lán hǎi shuǐ zhōng 。
sentences.english: The sun rose from the ocean and seabirds circled. The old man skillfully set his lines with sardine baits down to a depth of one hundred fathoms.

sentences.chinese: 正午时分，一根绿色的钓竿突然猛烈地下沉了一米。老人用手指轻轻捏住钓线，感受到了深处那沉重而巨大的拉力。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng wǔ shí fēn ， yī gēn lǜ sè de diào gān tū rán měng liè dì xià chén le yī mǐ 。 lǎo rén yòng shǒu zhǐ qīng qīng niē zhù diào xiàn ， gǎn shòu dào le shēn chù nà chén zhòng ér jù dà de lā lì 。
sentences.english: At noon, one of the green rods dipped violently. The old man touched the line softly with his fingers, sensing the tremendous weight pulling below.

sentences.chinese: “咬吧，”老人轻声自言自语，“咬一口吧，我的大鱼啊，吞下那新鲜的沙丁鱼吧。”
sentences.pinyin: “ yǎo bā ， ” lǎo rén qīng shēng zì yán zì yǔ ， “ yǎo yī kǒu bā ， wǒ de dà yú ā ， tūn xià nà xīn xiān de shā dīng yú bā 。 ”
sentences.english: "Bite it," the old man whispered. "Take it, my big fish, swallow the fresh sardines."

sentences.chinese: 鱼终于吞下了鱼钩！老人用尽全身力气猛地向上一拉，钓线瞬间紧绷如铁丝。
sentences.pinyin: yú zhōng yú tūn xià le yú gōu ！ lǎo rén yòng jìn quán shēn lì qì měng dì xiàng shàng yī lā ， diào xiàn shùn jiān jǐn bēng rú tiě sī 。
sentences.english: The fish took the hook! The old man hauled back with all his strength, the line tightening like iron wire.

sentences.chinese: 然而，这只巨兽并没有浮上水面，而是开始平稳而有力地拖着整条小船，向西北方向的无尽海域游去。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér ， zhè zhǐ jù shòu bìng méi yǒu fú shàng shuǐ miàn ， ér shì kāi shǐ píng wěn ér yǒu lì dì tuō zhuó zhěng tiáo xiǎo chuán ， xiàng xī běi fāng xiàng de wú jìn hǎi yù yóu qù 。
sentences.english: Yet the great creature did not surface; instead, it began towing the skiff steadily and powerfully toward the northwest into the endless sea.

title: 第三章：两天两夜的搏斗与“人不是生来要被打败的”
titleEn: Chapter 3: Two Days of Battle & "Man is Not Made for Defeat"

sentences.chinese: 大鱼拖着小船游了整整两天两夜。老人的后背被钓线勒得鲜血淋漓，左手也因抽筋而僵硬麻木。
sentences.pinyin: dà yú tuō zhuó xiǎo chuán yóu le zhěng zhěng liǎng tiān liǎng yè 。 lǎo rén de hòu bēi bèi diào xiàn lè dé xiān xiě lín lí ， zuǒ shǒu yě yīn chōu jīn ér jiāng yìng má mù 。
sentences.english: The giant fish towed the skiff for two full days and nights. The old man's back was cut by the line and his left hand cramped into a rigid claw.

sentences.chinese: 他只能靠嚼生飞鱼和吞几口淡水来维持微弱的体力，心里不断对自己说：“人不是生来要被打败的。你尽可以把他消灭掉，可就是打不败他！”
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ néng kào jiáo shēng fēi yú hé tūn jǐ kǒu dàn shuǐ lái wéi chí wēi ruò de tǐ lì ， xīn lǐ bù duàn duì zì jǐ shuō ： “ rén bù shì shēng lái yào bèi dǎ bài de 。 nǐ jìn kě yǐ bǎ tā xiāo miè diào ， kě jiù shì dǎ bù bài tā ！ ”
sentences.english: He sustained himself by chewing raw flying fish and sips of water, telling himself: "Man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated!"

sentences.chinese: 第三天早晨，大鱼终于开始绕着小船兜圈子。当巨鱼跃出水面时，老人看见它比整条小船还要长两英尺，周身闪耀着紫色的斑纹。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān tiān zǎo chén ， dà yú zhōng yú kāi shǐ rào zhuó xiǎo chuán dōu quān zǐ 。 dāng jù yú yuè chū shuǐ miàn shí ， lǎo rén kàn jiàn tā bǐ zhěng tiáo xiǎo chuán hái yào cháng liǎng yīng chǐ ， zhōu shēn shǎn yào zhuó zǐ sè de bān wén 。
sentences.english: On the third morning, the fish began circling the boat. When it leapt into the air, the old man saw it was two feet longer than the skiff, gleaming with purple stripes.

sentences.chinese: 老人强忍着头晕目眩，稳准狠地将手中的鱼叉刺入了大鱼的心脏。巨鱼在空中做最后一次绝望的翻腾，鲜血染红了碧蓝的海水。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén qiáng rěn zhuó tóu yūn mù xuàn ， wěn zhǔn hěn dì jiāng shǒu zhōng de yú chā cì rù le dà yú de xīn zàng 。 jù yú zài kōng zhōng zuò zuì hòu yī cì jué wàng de fān téng ， xiān xiě rǎn hóng le bì lán de hǎi shuǐ 。
sentences.english: Enduring blinding dizziness, the old man drove the harpoon cleanly into the giant fish's heart. The marlin made a final leap, blood staining the blue sea.

sentences.chinese: 老人把这条重达一千五百磅的大鱼绑在船舷边，升起风帆，踏上了凯旋的归途。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén bǎ zhè tiáo zhòng dá yī qiān wǔ bǎi bàng de dà yú bǎng zài chuán xián biān ， shēng qǐ fēng fān ， tà shàng le kǎi xuán de guī tú 。
sentences.english: The old man lashed the fifteen-hundred-pound marlin along the side of his skiff, raised his sail, and set a course for home.

title: 第四章：鲨鱼的围攻、森森白骨与狮子的梦境
titleEn: Chapter 4: The Shark Onslaught, The White Skeleton & The Lions

sentences.chinese: 鲜血在海水中蔓延开来，引来了第一条凶猛的灰鲭鲨。
sentences.pinyin: xiān xiě zài hǎi shuǐ zhōng màn yán kāi lái ， yǐn lái le dì yī tiáo xiōng měng de huī qīng shā 。
sentences.english: The blood spread through the water, drawing the first fierce mako shark from the depths.

sentences.chinese: 老人用鱼叉奋力刺死了第一条鲨鱼，但鱼叉和绳索也随之沉入了海底。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yòng yú chā fèn lì cì sǐ le dì yī tiáo shā yú ， dàn yú chā hé shéng suǒ yě suí zhī chén rù le hǎi dǐ 。
sentences.english: The old man drove his harpoon into the shark's brain, but the harpoon and rope sank into the sea with the dying beast.

sentences.chinese: 随后，成群结队的铲鼻鲨如恶魔般涌来，疯狂撕咬着马林鱼那鲜美的鱼肉。
sentences.pinyin: suí hòu ， chéng qún jié duì de chǎn bí shā rú è mó bān yǒng lái ， fēng kuáng sī yǎo zhuó mǎ lín yú nà xiān měi de yú ròu 。
sentences.english: Soon, packs of shovel-nosed sharks swarmed like demons, tearing voraciously into the marlin's tender flesh.

sentences.chinese: 老人把小刀绑在船桨上作为武器，小刀折断后又用短棍猛砸鲨鱼的头部。他战斗到了最后一刻，直到船边只剩下一具巨大的白色鱼骨。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén bǎ xiǎo dāo bǎng zài chuán jiǎng shàng zuò wéi wǔ qì ， xiǎo dāo zhé duàn hòu yòu yòng duǎn gùn měng zá shā yú de tóu bù 。 tā zhàn dòu dào le zuì hòu yī kè ， zhí dào chuán biān zhǐ shèng xià yī jù jù dà de bái sè yú gǔ 。
sentences.english: The old man lashed his knife to an oar; when the blade snapped, he fought with a club. He battled until only a towering white skeleton remained.

sentences.chinese: 深夜，老人疲惫不堪地划回了港口。他独自扛着沉重的桅杆走回小木屋，倒在床上沉沉睡去。
sentences.pinyin: shēn yè ， lǎo rén pí bèi bù kān dì huá huí le gǎng kǒu 。 tā dú zì káng zhuó chén zhòng de wéi gān zǒu huí xiǎo mù wū ， dǎo zài chuáng shàng chén chén shuì qù 。
sentences.english: In the dead of night, the exhausted old man rowed into the harbor. Carrying the heavy mast up the hill, he collapsed onto his bed into deep sleep.

sentences.chinese: 第二天清晨，所有的渔夫和游客都围在码头边，惊叹于那条长达十八英尺的巨大马林鱼脊骨。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān qīng chén ， suǒ yǒu de yú fū hé yóu kè dōu wéi zài mǎ tóu biān ， jīng tàn yú nà tiáo cháng dá shí bā yīng chǐ de jù dà mǎ lín yú jǐ gǔ 。
sentences.english: At dawn, fishermen and tourists gathered at the dock, marveling at the colossal eighteen-foot skeleton of the marlin.

sentences.chinese: 小男孩马诺林坐在老人的床边，看着老人布满伤痕的双手，流下了敬佩的泪水。而老人依然在睡梦中，安静地梦见着那些金黄色的狮子。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo nán hái mǎ nuò lín zuò zài lǎo rén de chuáng biān ， kàn zhuó lǎo rén bù mǎn shāng hén de shuāng shǒu ， liú xià le jìng pèi de lèi shuǐ 。 ér lǎo rén yī rán zài shuì mèng zhōng ， ān jìng dì mèng jiàn zhuó nà xiē jīn huáng sè de shī zǐ 。
sentences.english: The boy Manolin sat beside the old man's bed, weeping with reverence as he looked at the scarred hands. And the old man was dreaming of the golden lions.
